bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks are not allowed in the facility. All bags will be checked upon entry.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: The T-Mobile Center offers convenient on-site parking in the Magenta Lot, available for advance purchase on a first-come, first-served basis. Additional parking is available at the Red Lot Parking Garage and the Yellow Lot Parking Garage. Parking links for concerts can be found on individual event pages.

rideshare.note: Oak Street is open for passenger drop-off, including taxi or ride-share drop-off. It is also the place for ADA drop-off.

concessions.note: T-Mobile Center sells a range of food and beverages across arena concessions. Outside food and beverages are prohibited, and the venue operates cash-free points of sale.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by T-Mobile Center, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in T-Mobile Center's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Box Office at T-Mobile Center opens 3 hours prior to show time. *Please note on some events that begin prior to 12pm, the Box Office may have modified hours.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at T-Mobile Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
